name: pipeline
description: Takes an issue, or a pull request's review, to committed and reviewed work: the planner plans it, the build builds it task by task in a worktree of its own, the test writer writes its tests first, verify proves and reviews each change, the review follow-up reads review, and the cleanup clears what is merged

fiveHourPercent.title: 5-hour quota threshold (%)
fiveHourPercent.description: How full the 5-hour quota window may be for a run to start its next task. Past it, the run waits and goes on by itself once the window resets.

weeklyPercent.title: Weekly quota threshold (%)
weeklyPercent.description: How full the weekly quota window may be for a run to start its next task. Past it, the run stops for you: the window is days from resetting.

contextPercent.title: Builder context budget (%)
contextPercent.description: How much of a 200k-token context window a builder may fill before it is stopped and its task said to be too large, to be split.
